decision.rationale: I'm declining this dispute because it was opened too late. Transaction TXN-007968 (BRIGHTWATER DEVICES, 678.54 EUR, card CRD-000054) posted on 2026-06-19. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-26, which is 129 days later. Policy time-limits requires a dispute to be opened within 120 days of posting and says a later dispute is declined, even when the transaction carries fraud indicators. Authorisation AUTH-008171 does look like an unauthorised payment: entry mode ECOMMERCE, 3-D Secure NOT_PERFORMED, CVV NOT_PRESENT, fraud flag set. There were also no earlier purchases on this card at this merchant. But under the policy's order the time limit is checked first, so it decides the case before these signals are considered.

proposed_actions.reason: The dispute was opened 129 days after the transaction posted on 2026-06-19. Disputes must be opened within 120 days of the posting date, and this limit applies even when a transaction shows signs of fraud.
